name: crypto_price
description: Real-time cryptocurrency price tool powered by CoinGecko. Input: coin (string, required) — coin name or ticker e.g. bitcoin, BTC, ethereum, ETH, solana, SOL, cardano, ADA, dogecoin, DOGE. currency (string, optional, default usd) — target fiat currency code e.g. usd, eur, gbp, jpy. include_market_data (boolean, optional, default true) — controls whether market_cap and volume_24h are returned. Output: price (number), change_24h_pct (number), market_cap (number), volume_24h (number), coin_id (string), coin_input (string), currency (string), last_updated (ISO 8601 string), data_source (string). Covers 10,000+ CoinGecko-listed coins.

coin.description: Cryptocurrency name or ticker symbol. Accepts common symbols (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, MATIC, LINK, AVAX) or full names (bitcoin, ethereum, solana). Case-insensitive.

currency.description: Target fiat currency code for the price. Defaults to USD. Examples: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, chf, aud, cad.

include_market_data.description: Whether to include market capitalisation and 24-hour trading volume alongside the price. Defaults to true.
